# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run references`; edit its sources, not this file. -->

This generated reference is for users authoring or reviewing `cockpit.toml`. It is generated from the schema cockpit validates against, so it matches this version. For the handful of tables a typical cockpit sets, start with [Configuration essentials](configuration-essentials.md).

The same schema ships as JSON Schema in [`cockpit.schema.json`](../packages/cockpit/cockpit.schema.json), installed at `node_modules/@b00dea/cockpit/cockpit.schema.json`; point an editor at it for completion and validation as you type.

## Defaults

The values cockpit uses for a key the configuration leaves out.

```json
{
  "cockpit": {
    "siblings_root": "..",
    "guide_cap": 200
  },
  "sibling": {
    "toolchain": "none",
    "guides": [
      "CLAUDE.md",
      "AGENTS.md"
    ],
    "instruction_pointer": false
  },
  "ports": {
    "step": 100,
    "count": 27
  },
  "guards": {
    "hosted_db_hosts": [],
    "vendor_endpoint_hosts": [],
    "protected_branches": [
      "main",
      "master"
    ],
    "allow": [],
    "deny": []
  },
  "mcp": {
    "approved": {}
  },
  "workorders": {
    "attempt_cap": 2,
    "wip_cap": 3,
    "verification_timeout_seconds": 1800,
    "evaluator_timeout_seconds": 900
  },
  "environment": {
    "resettable_volumes": [],
    "generated_host_paths": [],
    "compose_files": [],
    "entrypoint_derivatives": [],
    "install_policies": []
  },
  "surfaces": {
    "overlays": [],
    "harnesses": [],
    "bundles": [],
    "adopted": []
  }
}
```

## Tables

Each section is one TOML table: `[name]` holds one, `[[name]]` repeats. A table accepts only the keys it lists unless its rules below say otherwise. Rules are JSON Schema fragments that relate several keys of the same table. A pattern is a regular expression the value must contain a match for; `^` and `$` in it make it cover the whole value. A type that links to a shape is a table whose keys are listed once, under [Shapes](#shapes).

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `unconfirmed` | Answers no person has stated yet; init writes them and doctor reports them. | array of string |  | 1–12 items; each item: one of `"cockpit.name"`, `"sibling"`, `"estate.runnable"`, `"ports.bases"`, `"environment.install_policies"`, `"environment.test_data"`, `"environment.generated"`, `"environment.compose_files"`, `"environment.machine"`, `"environment.posture"`, `"testing"`, `"guards"` |

| `ports` | Port leasing for running stacks side by side. | table: [`[ports]`](#ports) |  | required |
| `guards` | Rules that restrict what agents may run. | table: [`[guards]`](#guards) | `{}` |  |
| `mcp` | Approval of MCP servers. | table: [`[mcp]`](#mcp) | `{}` |  |

| `environment` | How the stack is reached, signed in to, built and kept. | table: [`[environment]`](#environment) | `{}` |  |
| `surfaces` | Instructions, skills and settings generated for agent tools. | table: [`[surfaces]`](#surfaces) | `{}` |  |

- Must match `{"anyOf":[{"not":{"required":["browser"],"properties":{"browser":{"required":["resources"]}}}},{"required":["environment"],"properties":{"environment":{"required":["generated"]}}}]}`.

### `[cockpit]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Name of this cockpit. | string |  | required; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `siblings_root` | Directory holding the sibling checkouts, relative to the cockpit. | string | `".."` |  |
| `guide_cap` | Most lines of always-loaded guidance; preflight fails above it. | integer | `200` | greater than 0; at most 9007199254740991 |

### `[[sibling]]`

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slug` | Short name of the sibling; also the prefix of its projected guide files. | string |  | required; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `dir` | Checkout directory under the siblings root, or . for the siblings root itself. | string |  | required; either (exactly `"."`) or (pattern [P1](#patterns)) |
| `remote` | Git remote to clone from; required when acquire is auto or manual and not allowed when none. | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `branch` | Branch to check out when cloning. | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `mount` | How the stack uses the checkout: always mounted, mounted under a profile, host only, or not mounted. | string |  | required; either (one of `"always"`, `"host"`, `"none"`) or (pattern `^profile:[a-z0-9-]+$`) |
| `acquire` | How the checkout reaches disk: cloned by setup, cloned by a person, or not a repository. | string |  | required; one of `"auto"`, `"manual"`, `"none"` |
| `var` | Name of the exported *_DIR environment variable that points at the checkout. | string |  | required; pattern `^(?!(?:DOCKER_\|COMPOSE_\|LD_\|DYLD_\|LIBPATH$\|SHLIB_PATH$\|NODE_OPTIONS$\|NODE_PATH$\|BASH_ENV$\|ENV$\|PATH$\|IFS$))[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` |
| `toolchain` | Toolchain that installs and tests the sibling; none for a directory of data. | string | `"none"` | one of `"node"`, `"python"`, `"ruby"`, `"go"`, `"rust"`, `"dotnet"`, `"none"` |
| `gate` | Set to operator for a lane that touches live data or local hardware; it never runs by default and asks first. | string |  | exactly `"operator"` |
| `host_reason` | Why the sibling cannot join the stack; required when mount is host. | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `guides` | Guide files the sibling publishes, linked into the cockpit as symlinks. | array of string | `["CLAUDE.md","AGENTS.md"]` | each item: pattern [P1](#patterns) |
| `instruction_pointer` | Let setup add a pointer to the cockpit guide in this sibling, when the command line also approves it. | boolean | `false` |  |
| `purpose` | What the sibling is for; printed when its checkout is missing. | string |  | required; at least 1 character |
| `environment_files` | Template and instance environment file pairs the sibling needs. | array of table: [`[[sibling.environment_files]]`](#siblingenvironment_files) |  |  |
| `derives` | Facts about the sibling that cockpit derives rows or MCP servers from. | table: [`[sibling.derives]`](#siblingderives) |  |  |

- Must match `{"oneOf":[{"properties":{"acquire":{"enum":["none"]}},"not":{"required":["remote"]}},{"properties":{"acquire":{"enum":["auto","manual"]}},"required":["remote"]}]}`.
- Must match `{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"mount":{"enum":["host"]}},"required":["host_reason"]},{"properties":{"mount":{"not":{"enum":["host"]}}}}]}`.
- Must match `{"not":{"required":["mount","derives"],"properties":{"mount":{"enum":["none","host"]},"derives":{"required":["generated"]}}}}`.
- Must match `{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"gate":{"enum":["operator"]}},"required":["gate"]},{"not":{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"mount":{"enum":["host"]}}},{"properties":{"purpose":{"pattern":"\\b(?:[lL][iI][vV][eE]|[pP][rR][oO][dD][uU][cC][tT][iI][oO][nN]|[hH][aA][rR][dD][wW][aA][rR][eE]|[sS][iI][mM][uU][lL][aA][tT][oO][rR])\\b"}}}]}}]}`.

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hosted_db_hosts` | Hosted database host names the guards keep agents away from. | array of string | `[]` | at most 128 items; each item: pattern [P10](#patterns) |

| `deny` | Commands refused in addition to the built-in rules. | array of table, one of: [`[[guards.deny]]` form 1](#guardsdeny-form-1), [`[[guards.deny]]` form 2](#guardsdeny-form-2) | `[]` | at most 64 items |

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |

| `cwd` | Allow only when run from this directory, relative to the cockpit. | string |  | either (exactly `"."`) or (pattern [P1](#patterns), at most 4096 characters) |

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |

| `contains` | Argument sequence that is refused wherever it appears in a command. | array of string |  | required; 1–32 items; each item: pattern [P9](#patterns) |
| `reason` | Why the command is refused. | string |  | required; 1–512 characters; pattern `\S`; pattern `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]+$` |

## Shapes

These tables recur in several places; each place links here instead of repeating the keys.

### `additional_mounts` shape

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |

| `kind` | Whether the source is a bind-mounted path, a named volume or an environment file. | string |  | required; one of `"bind"`, `"volume"`, `"environment-file"` |
| `source` | Path in the sibling, or the declared volume id when kind is volume. | string |  | required; either (exactly `"."`) or (pattern [P1](#patterns), at most 4096 characters) |

| `source_type` | Whether a bind source is a file or a directory; required for bind mounts. | string |  | one of `"file"`, `"directory"` |

- Must match exactly one of `[{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["volume"]},"source":{"not":{"enum":["."]}}},"not":{"required":["source_type"]}},{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["bind"]}},"required":["source_type"]},{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["environment-file"]},"source_type":{"enum":["file"]}},"required":["source_type"]}]`.

| `subject_id` | Identity of the structure the decision is about. | string |  | required; 1–4096 characters |

| Key | Meaning | Type | Default | Constraints |

## Patterns

Long patterns that several keys share, cited by name in the tables.

| Pattern | Regular expression |
| --- | --- |
| P1 | `^(?!\/)(?![A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:)(?!.*(?:^\|\/)\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*\\)(?:[^/\x00-\x1f\x7f]+\/)*[^/\x00-\x1f\x7f]+$` |
| P2 | `^(?:(?:\d\d[2468][048]\|\d\d[13579][26]\|\d\d0[48]\|[02468][048]00\|[13579][26]00)-02-29\|\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]\|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|3[01])\|(?:0[469]\|11)-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|30)\|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]\|1\d\|2[0-8])))$` |
| P3 | `^(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| P4 | `^(?:(?:25[0-5]\|2[0-4][0-9]\|1[0-9][0-9]\|[1-9][0-9]\|[0-9])\.){3}(?:25[0-5]\|2[0-4][0-9]\|1[0-9][0-9]\|[1-9][0-9]\|[0-9])$` |
| P5 | `^(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){7}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,7}:\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,6}:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,5}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,2}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,4}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,3}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,3}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,4}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,2}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,5}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:((:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,6})\|:((:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,7}\|:))$` |
| P6 | `^\/(?!\/)(?!.*(?:^\|\/)\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*[\\\x00-\x1f\x7f])[^:]+$` |
| P7 | `^\/(?!\/)(?!\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*\/\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*[%\\?#\x00-\x20\x7f]).*$` |
| P8 | `^(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+localhost(?![\s\S])` |
| P9 | `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f\uD800-\uDFFF]{1,128}(?![\s\S])` |
| P10 | `^(?:\*\.)?(?=[a-z0-9.-]{1,253}(?![\s\S]))[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(?:\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*(?![\s\S])` |
| P11 | `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9./:_-]*@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$` |
| P12 | `^(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)(?:-(?:0\|[1-9]\d*\|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)(?:\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*\|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*)?$` |
| P13 | `^(?!.*(?:^\|\/)(?:\.git\|internal\|node_modules)(?:\/\|$)).+$` |

## Checks beyond the schema

cockpit checks these rules when it loads the configuration (`x-cockpit-runtime-checks` in the JSON Schema). An editor validating against the JSON Schema does not report the ones marked in the last column (`x-cockpit-editor-limitations`).

| Path | Rule | Not reported by editors |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sibling[].slug` | `unique` |  |
| `sibling[].dir` | `unique` |  |
| `sibling[].var` | `unique` |  |
| `sibling[].environment_files[].instance` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.resettable_volumes[]` | `unique` |  |
| `environment.resettable_volumes[]` | `declared_compose_volume_key` |  |
| `environment.generated_host_paths[]` | `unique` |  |
| `environment.compose_files[]` | `unique` |  |
| `environment.entrypoint_derivatives[].name` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.install_policies[].volume` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.install_policies[].toolchain+lockfile` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.posture_requirements[].requirement` | `unique` | yes |
| `environment.entrypoint_derivatives[].port` | `declared_in_ports.bases` | yes |
| `browser.artifacts` | `exact_environment.generated_host_paths_coverage` | yes |
| `browser` | `matches_environment_addressing_authentication_and_client_cap` | yes |
| `browser.images` | `runner_driver_equals_project_driver_and_mcp_driver_shares_major_minor` | yes |
| `testing.gates[].stages[]` | `references_declared_testing_stage` | yes |
| `sibling[].environment_files[]` | `template_and_instance_differ` | yes |
| `sibling[].derives.generated` | `row_owned_relations_and_exact_port_defaults` | yes |
| `sibling[].derives.mcp_sources[].path` | `unique_within_sibling` | yes |
| `sibling[].derives` | `global_baseline_and_cross_row_identity_disjointness` | yes |
| `ports` | `count_times_base_count_within_shared_input_budget` (limit 4096) |  |
| `surfaces.overlays[].name` | `unique` | yes |
| `surfaces.overlays[].sources[].path` | `unique` | yes |
| `surfaces.overlays[].sources` | `feature_namespace_and_complete_skill_definitions` | yes |
| `surfaces.overlays[].sources[].bytes` | `utf8_byte_length_at_most_65536` | yes |
| `surfaces.overlays[].replaces.name` | `matches_declaration_name` | yes |
| `surfaces.harnesses[].name` | `unique` | yes |
| `surfaces.harnesses[].capabilities` | `one_row_per_surface_feature` | yes |
| `surfaces.harnesses[].capabilities[].spelling` | `unique_when_emitted` | yes |
| `surfaces.adopted[].path` | `unique` | yes |
| `surfaces.adopted[].source` | `equals_cockpit/adopted/<path>` | yes |

## Skill size limits

Agent tools load every skill's frontmatter into each session and its entry point whenever the skill is used, so cockpit caps both and keeps the detail in a procedure file the agent reads only when it needs it. The limits come from `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/collection.json`, SHA-256 `738daf2662c9504c7493183159684508075aa0d0d5364ddb3f0f3719c4842eec`.

| Target | Measured as | Limit | Detail moved to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| claudecode | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| codexcli | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| opencode | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| cursor | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| grokcli | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |

| Skill entry point | Measured as | Limit | Detail moved to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
